// diagnostic

L0103

Import `{name}` is never used.

What

Import `{name}` is never used.

Why

An unused import adds a name and dependency to the file without contributing to checked code.

Fix

remove the import, or rename `{name}` to `_{name}` when the import is intentionally kept.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0103: tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.stderr.

Error [E0112]: `Secret` can't be reflected yet
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:19:29
    |
 19 |     reflected :: reflect.of(left)
    |                             ^^^^
 Why: `reflect.of` inspects the same values `"{x}"` interpolation can show
 Fix: implement `Display` for its type, or pass one of its fields instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0905]: `Secret` does not implement `Encode`
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:20:21
    |
 20 |     encoded :: left.encode()
    |                     ^^^^^^
 Why: `.encode()` can only call the value's Encode contract
 Fix: derive `Encode` on `Secret`, or write `impl Secret.Encode`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0905

Error [E0102]: `Secret` has no method `clone`
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:21:20
    |
 21 |     cloned :: left.clone()
    |                    ^^^^^
 Why: check the method name on this type
 Fix: define it inside `struct Secret` or `impl Secret`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102

Error [E0102]: `Secret` has no method `hash`
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:22:20
    |
 22 |     hashed :: left.hash()
    |                    ^^^^
 Why: check the method name on this type
 Fix: define it inside `struct Secret` or `impl Secret`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102

Warning [L0101] (unused_local_binding): local binding `reflected` is never read.
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:19:5
    |
 19 |     reflected :: reflect.of(left)
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A binding that no later expression reads adds dead code and may hide a computed result that should have been used.
 Fix: remove the binding when its initializer is side-effect free, or rename `reflected` to `_reflected` when the value must be computed.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0101

Warning [L0103] (unused_import): import `reflect` is never used.
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_local_operations.jet:6:21
    |
  6 | use core.reflect as reflect
    |                     ^^^^^^^
 Why: an unused import adds a name and dependency to the file without contributing to checked code.
 Fix: remove the import, or rename `reflect` to `_reflect` when the import is intentionally kept.
